scope: New FF++ bounded-quartet investigation; not full-coverage CES or FF2
priority: Next available authorized GPU allocation; never preempt existing work
hypothesis: Matching responses to controlled added manipulation across age appearances improves fairness while retaining manipulation sensitivity better than ordinary score consistency.
budget: 50 original-only P epochs shared, then 50 per downstream arm; 300 epochs total if all five arms run
changed_factors: TRAIN-only real-image soft FPR disparity at fixed logit 0
Bounded age quartet bank; unique real TRAIN sources only; matched operation after editing
Response alignment plus positive operation-response margins
original_exposure: Every original once each epoch, shuffled; inverse label x ids8 cell weights; same head seed and encoder checkpoint
counterfactual_exposure: Independent deterministic bank sample of up to four quartets per original minibatch; repetition is logged, NOT full TRAIN coverage
selection: Validation AUC only; frozen validation-real 10% FPR threshold and separately reported fixed0.5
novelty: Unproven research hypothesis; no 8/10 or SOTA claim
primary_validation_endpoint: gender_race Ding-style F_FPR at frozen validation-calibrated operating point; report FNR, F_DP, es-AUC and AUC as well
decision_rule: Advance response hypothesis only if validation primary fairness improves against fair AND score arms without >0.5pp AUC degradation relative to fair; prespecified development rule, not significance or test superiority
external_test_policy: No test command in this package; existing test results have been viewed. Separate locked evaluation/uncertainty plan and untouched confirmation evidence needed.
dependencies: Cluster CUDA smoke for current hashes
Matched manipulation operator selection, code/settings/donor provenance and real output review
Reviewed bank covers each real TRAIN gender_race group with older and younger directions using unique non-VAL contributors
FF2_status: DO NOT RUN; prior review blockers unchanged
